q1_issues.issue: Location is attached to an entity (sk_error_1) rather than to an eventuality, which the instruction set forbids outright — the head is what marks the event-vs-entity distinction, and an entity's position takes LocatedIn.
"discovers" accepts the progressive and is named in the instruction set as an event verb whose subject is an ordinary Agent ("coming to know something is an act"), so Experiencer is the wrong role.
Since discover is not a stative psych/perception verb, its object is not a Stimulus; the object is unchanged by the discovering, so the yes/no change test gives Theme.

notes: The instruction set names discover twice as a progressive-accepting event verb taking Agent, but the propositional-attitudes section also lists discover among the factives and says a psych/attitude verb with an entity object "keeps Experiencer / Stimulus" — a likely source of the role choice, even though that bullet cross-refers back to Thematic roles. It also never exemplifies a noun-attached locative PP with a non-geographic container ("an error in the ledger"), giving no worked case for LocatedIn there, though it does forbid Location on an entity explicitly.
